title: Initiates at Eleusis came away believing they were immortal
summary: unidentified clip speaker tells of Initiates at Eleusis came away believing they were immortal, about antiquity at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: People went to Eleusis as human beings, they walked away thinking they were immortal.

plain: Eleusis is an ancient religious site in Greece, where people in antiquity went through secret rites. A speaker in a clip on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passing on what someone else told them, says that people arrived at Eleusis as ordinary human beings and walked away thinking they were immortal. Told this way, it suggests that something at those ancient rites changed how people saw death itself.
